title: The Möbius strip has only one side
lede: A marker with a gold arrow walks along the center line. The blue arrow marks where it started. Walk one lap and compare. Then cut the strip along the middle.
notice: After one lap the marker is back at the start but its arrow points the opposite way. The strip has no consistent side to call up.
After two laps the arrow agrees with the start again. Going around twice undoes the flip.
Cutting along the middle gives one band, not two. It is twice as long and half as wide, has two sides again, and carries two full twists.
hint: Slide the walker, or press Walk. Tick the cut box. Drag to rotate.
